label: Agent Sprite Forge
qualityReason: Codex-first workflow for planning and post-processing transparent sprite sheets, prop sheets, GIF previews, and layered 2D map metadata from original prompts.
intakeNotes: Optional operator-installed tooling only. Do not vendor the repository, do not add a runtime dependency, and do not use its showcase/franchise examples as source material. Any output must enter the generator-assisted pipeline with prompt records, rights review, normalization, and manifest validation.
shippingPosture: Tooling reference only; outputs can ship only as project-original or otherwise reviewed assets after arpg:assets:check passes.

label: Sprite Fusion Pixel Snapper
qualityReason: Local Rust/WASM cleanup tool for snapping inconsistent pixel, procedural, or generated 2D art to a stable grid and palette before review.
intakeNotes: Optional local cleanup tooling only. If adopted, run it after source approval and before manifest intake; it does not grant rights to upstream art and does not replace provenance, prompt records, frame sizing, or visible-credit requirements.
shippingPosture: Tooling reference only; cleaned images remain blocked from runtime until the source art and normalized output are manifest-tracked.
